results.mechanism: Antioxidant protection against oxidative DNA damage
results.why: SELECT trial found no prevention benefit (increased risk)
results.question: Does alpha-tocopherol reduce a direct biomarker of oxidative DNA damage (8-oxo-dG) in prostate tissue or urine compared with placebo, and does this depend on smoking status?

results.why: ATBC and CARET trials found increased incidence in smokers
results.question: Does beta-carotene supplementation in smokers shift antioxidant/oxidative-stress markers in the direction the antioxidant mechanism predicts, and do those shifts track lung cancer risk?

results.mechanism: Improved lipid profile and vascular protection

Does thalidomide plus dexamethasone outperform dexamethasone alone in relapsed myeloma, and does any benefit track with marrow microvessel density change and CRBN expression?
